description:
Even the smallest animals are getting caught in the effects of war 💔

This tiny owl became trapped in an anti-drone net in Ukraine, but thankfully the people who spotted her knew exactly how to help. Dodo editor Brielle shares how Dr. Valentina and Dr. Leonid from Vet Crew rescued her and brought her to their veterinary hospital for the care she needed.

Help Vet Crew save more animals ❤️‍🩹 Click the link in our bio to learn how.

Hosted by Brielle
Produced by Anita
fulltitle: Owl Trapped In Anti-Drone Net Gets Found By The Right People | The Dodo
